reviews.summary: The home page now has section#latest-day ahead of every h2, linking to /day/2026-11-11/, and its per-product numbers match today.json. build.json shows home_check ok and every other check list empty; the required pages return 200 and the unknown path returns 404.

The live robots.txt, sitemap.xml and build.json match the acceptance criteria. The release was deployed (build.json commit ecc18ac). The four named pages return 200, the sitemap has 21 URLs with varying lastmod values, and unknown paths still return 404.

The live day page for 2026-11-11 has section#day-lead right after the h1 and before the first h2. Its numbers match index.json, it links to an existing anchor, and build.json shows lead_check with 11 pages and no issues. All other checks are empty and the key pages return the expected status codes.

The live day page for 2026-11-11 has the 'What went wrong' block with an h2. It lists exactly the two blocked tasks from index.json, with working anchors and the not-in-the-export line. build.json shows a green broke_check and all the other check lists empty. The other pages return 200 and the unknown path still returns 404.

The live /day/2026-11-11/ has a single #what-broke section. Old anchors resolve inside it, the listed tasks match index.json, and the rate-limit line is kept. build.json shows broke_check with duplicate_blocks [] and every other check clean, and the other URLs return 200 with the unknown path still 404.

The live feed has 11 items, each with the day-lead text, a failure-count line and a ?src=rss link. The 2026-11-11 item matches the day page, and build.json shows a clean feed_check with every other check still empty.

The live site passes every acceptance criterion I could observe. build.json has id_check with 30 pages checked and empty lists, and the 2026-11-11 task links resolve to product-slug-prefixed ids that exist once.

The icon paths return 200 image/png, and the head link is present on the three pages I checked. build.json paths_check lists all three paths with missing = [], and all the other check lists are empty.

| Уровень | 10.11 | 11.11 | 12.11 (частично) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Люди: источники / engaged | 11 / 3 | 66 / 4 | 5 / 2 |
| Возвраты | 0 | 2 | 1 |
| Агенты (запросы) | 83 | 5 | 4 |
| Краулеры (запросы) | 95 | 78 | 87 |
| 4xx / 5xx | 181 / 0 | 628 / 0 | 168 / 0 |

**Цели (по видимым дням):**
- G1: engaged за 06–10.11 = 26 при цели ≥50, не дотягивает.
- G2: возвраты за 06–10.11 = 2 при цели ≥5. Вместе с 11–12.11 получается 5, но это уже вне окна.
- G3: людей на `/try/` = 3 источника, на `/go/github/` = 1, при цели ≥10, не дотягивает.
- G4: данных об Issue и ответах в prompt нет.
- G5: выполнена. ClaudeBot заходил 06.11 (26 запросов) и 07.11 (6). Запросы python-requests и curl могут быть нашими прогонами.

**Каналы по ?src=.** Telegram 11.11: 10 human-источников, 0 engaged. В списке постов нет поста Telegram после 09.11, так что откуда этот трафик, неясно. X: 1 human и 1 engaged в день, это самый стабильный канал. Bluesky, Threads и Mastodon: 0 engaged.

**Пост X 12.11 16:11.** Почасовых данных нет, до/после по часам сравнить нельзя. За весь день x = 7 запросов, 1 human, referer t.co.
